name: 85355 · Waddell, AZ
findings: ZIP 85355 (Waddell) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85355 (Waddell) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
